verdict.rationale: The RTX 5080 is a discrete graphics card. A requirement that everything in the UI also be doable through an API is a software or SaaS openness axis, not something a GPU ships as a capability. The CUDA Toolkit is a compute programming environment and the NVIDIA app is a companion settings utility; neither is evidenced as an API mirroring a UI. The OpenAPI probe found no spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
